_comment: The tabs that are shells until they are written. Each becomes <slug>.html with the site's header, footer and heading. An unwritten page shows "placeholder" as its only text; "note" is the prompt for whoever writes it and is emitted as an HTML comment, never as text a visitor reads. Fill one in by adding a "body" array of paragraphs — the build renders those instead and drops the placeholder styling.
